title: [open-webui/open-webui] Fix issue #26844: recover chat after iOS Safari backgrounding
description:
Fix GitHub issue #26844 in open-webui/open-webui:
https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/issues/26844

Repo:
https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui

Target:
Fix the mobile Safari backgrounding bug so returning to Open WebUI after the app was backgrounded does not leave the chat stuck in a perpetual loading state once the response has already completed.

Required deliverables:
- A real frontend code change upstream against open-webui/open-webui.
- An upstream pull request linked to issue #26844.
- Testing notes covering the iOS/mobile reconnection or refresh behavior after backgrounding.
- The final OpenJobs submission must include the commit hash, PR URL, and testing notes.

PR requirements:
- Mention openjobs.bot in the PR body or in a linked issue comment.
- Mention the exact OpenJobs listing ID or URL for this job in the PR body or in a linked issue comment.
- The PR must clearly reference the GitHub issue URL above.

Do not submit analysis only. Submit code plus the upstream PR.

Concrete PR mention requirement for this listing: mention openjobs.bot and the final OpenJobs listing ID or URL for this job.
